description: Verify that DHCPREQUEST IPv4 source address field is 0 in REQUESTING state (RFC 2131 §4.1 MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
In REQUESTING the client still hasn't been confirmed as the owner of the offered yiaddr — only an OFFER has arrived. So the IPv4 src_ip on the wire must remain 0.0.0.0 until ACK lands and BOUND begins.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → wire: DHCPDISCOVER.
2. Tester → DUT: DHCPOFFER.
3. DUT → wire: DHCPREQUEST
   • IPv4 src_ip == 0.0.0.0   ← key check

[Pass condition]
REQUEST's IPv4 src_ip is 0.0.0.0.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_discover / Fail_no_request — DORA missing
• Fail_request_src_ip_not_zero — REQUEST src_ip is not zero

verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_request_src_ip_not_zero: DUT DHCPREQUEST source IP is not zero
